title: Ad platform support
content:
# Ad platform support

A single matrix showing which advertising operations the Zernio Ads API supports on each ad platform - creation, analytics, breakdowns, audiences, conversions, and more.

import { Callout } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/callout';
import { Card, Cards } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/card';

The [Ads API](/ad-campaigns/list-ads) is one unified surface across nine ad platforms:

- **Meta** (Facebook & Instagram)
- **Google**
- **LinkedIn**
- **TikTok**
- **Pinterest**
- **X**
- **OpenAI**
- **Reddit**
- **Microsoft** (Bing search)

Each platform's own API exposes a different set of capabilities. Zernio cannot add what a platform does not offer.

This page maps which platforms support each operation.

<Callout type="info">
**Meta is the most complete surface** — it supports every operation below. The other platforms cover the common paths (create, read, manage, analytics, audiences, conversions) with platform-specific gaps noted underneath.
</Callout>

<Callout type="info">
**Pricing:** managed ads meter at **$0.01 per active ad per month** after the first 500 free, and only running or in-review ads count. See [Managed ads pricing](/pricing/ads#managed-ads).
</Callout>

## Support matrix

✓ = supported · — = not available on this platform

| Operation | Meta | Google | LinkedIn | TikTok | Pinterest | X |
|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| Create a standalone ad | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Boost an existing post | ✓ | — | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Click-to-WhatsApp ad | ✓ | — | — | — | — | — |
| List & read ads | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Pause / resume / change budget | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Edit targeting or creative | ✓ | — | — | ✓ | — | — |
| Rename an ad | ✓ | — | — | — | — | — |
| List campaigns & change status | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Delete or duplicate a campaign | ✓ | — | — | ✓ | — | — |
| Campaign budget / bid-strategy edits | ✓ | — | — | — | — | — |
| Spend & performance metrics | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| **Demographic breakdowns — per ad** | ✓ | — | — | ✓ | — | — |
| **Demographic breakdowns — per campaign** | ✓ | — | — | — | — | — |
| Create audiences & upload members | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Search interests & targeting | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | — |
| Estimate reach before launch | ✓ | — | ✓ | — | ✓ | ✓ |
| Lead forms | ✓ | — | — | — | — | — |
| Product catalogs | ✓ | — | — | — | — | — |
| Send conversions (CAPI) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | — | — |
| Adjust conversions | — | ✓ | — | — | — | — |
| Conversion quality (Event Match) | ✓ | — | — | — | — | — |
| Conversion destinations | list¹ | create¹ | ✓ | list¹ | — | — |
| Ad URL tracking tags | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | — | — | — |
| Tracking-tag resource (pixels) | ✓ | — | — | — | — | — |

¹ Conversion destinations differ by platform, see the note below.

## Notes that matter

**Demographic breakdowns** (the `breakdowns` parameter on [ad analytics](/ad-insights/get-ad-analytics)) are the most commonly misjudged. They work **per ad on Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn only**, and **per campaign on Meta only**.

Spend and performance metrics themselves are available everywhere. It is the age/gender/geo splits that are gated.

| Platform | Breakdown dimensions |
|---|---|
| Meta | `age, gender, country, publisher_platform, device_platform, region` |
| TikTok | `gender, age, country_code, platform, ac, language` |

**Editing ads after launch** splits by capability, not just platform:

- Pausing, resuming, and budget changes work on all six.
- **Changing targeting or creative is Meta and TikTok only.** On the other platforms you delete and recreate.
- **Renaming** an ad and **campaign-level budget/bid edits** are Meta-only.

**Audiences** can be created and populated on all six, but:

- **Email is the universal key**: only Meta also matches on phone; other platforms ignore `phone`. All PII is SHA-256 hashed server-side.
- **TikTok and Pinterest** create the audience lazily on the first member upload (no platform ID until then); TikTok needs ~48h before it is targetable.
- **LinkedIn** uploads *replace* the list (not append), and LinkedIn segments cannot be deleted via API (only in Campaign Manager).
- **X** (Tailored Audiences) needs ≥100 matched active users before it can be targeted.

**Conversions.** The send path (CAPI) covers Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and TikTok. Beyond sending:

- **Adjust conversions** (restatements) is **Google only**.
- **Event Match Quality** feedback is **Meta only**.
- **Conversion destinations**: LinkedIn has full create/read/update/delete; Google is create + list; Meta and TikTok are list-only (Meta's are its pixels, managed in Meta's own UI).

**Two different "tracking tags".** Do not conflate them.

- *Ad URL tracking tags* (read/update the `trackingUrlTemplate` and `finalUrlSuffix` on an ad) work on Meta, Google, and LinkedIn.
- The separate *tracking-tag resource* (create and manage Meta pixels) is Meta-only.
